title: Recovery of a Null Form in the Wave Equation from Scattering Data
summary: We use highly oscillatory geometric optics solutions to solve the inverse problem for the system $$ \square \begin{bmatrix} u^{(1)}\\ u^{(2)}\\ \vdots\\ u^{(n)}\end{bmatrix} = \sum_{k\geq l=1}^n \left(Q_0(u^{(k)},u^{(l)}) \begin{bmatrix} q_{1kl}\\q_{2kl}\\\vdots\\q_{nkl} \end{bmatrix} + \sum_{i>j=1}^d Q_{ij}(u^{(k)},u^{(l)})\begin{bmatrix} p_{1ijkl} \\ p_{2ijkl} \\ \vdots \\ p_{nijkl} \end{bmatrix}\right), $$ where $Q_0$ and $Q_{ij}$ are the symmetric and anti-symmetric bilinear null forms.
